sketch: The server is brisk and a little busy — short answers, no small talk. It is lunchtime and most tables are full. A pot of tea sits on the counter.

opening_line.pinyin: nǐ hǎo! nǐ yào diǎn shénme?

learner_turn: 好的，那我要一个夹子和一杯茶
notes: Stream A table, third miss. Ordered a dish and a drink after both answers; credited neither. 夹子 is a near-miss for 饺子 (the dish just recommended). The order slot is one fact that names two things, and missing both is two of the four slot-credits the table records.
